title: Ethereum ETFs see $226 million inflow on Thursday, strongest day in 10 months
dek: Ethereum ETFs recorded $226 million in inflows on a single day, the highest daily tally in 10 months. Nine consecutive sessions have brought in $1.4 billion total, per Decrypt's reporting.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: $226 million flowed into Ethereum ETFs on Thursday, marking the strongest single day in 10 months and part of a nine-session streak totaling $1.4 billion in inflows.
bottom_line: Readers should watch for whether the nine-session inflow streak continues and whether reporting clarifies which ETF products and geographic regions are driving the flows. A break in the streak or a return to outflows would signal a shift in institutional positioning.
body:
Ethereum ETFs recorded $226 million in inflows on Thursday, marking their strongest single day in 10 months, according to Decrypt. The inflow is part of a nine-session streak that has brought $1.4 billion into the funds.
The pace of inflows stands against a period of institutional hesitancy toward Ethereum. Decrypt does not specify which Ethereum ETF products are included in the figure or whether the total covers U.S., international, or global markets; it also does not detail what factors drove the consecutive sessions of inflows or how Thursday's single-day haul compares to Bitcoin ETF inflows on the same day, despite the headline's reference to matching Bitcoin's numbers.
